hero.heading: Product analytics for SaaS teams
hero.subheading: See why users churn, where trials drop off and which features drive retention. Events, funnels, retention, cohorts and user profiles, the core analytics stack for SaaS, without Mixpanel or Amplitude's enterprise pricing.

problem.title: Why SaaS teams outgrow their analytics tools
problem.intro: The analytics tools most SaaS teams start with either can't answer the right questions or become unaffordable as you grow.

items.title: Mixpanel and Amplitude become unaffordable at scale
items.description: Event-based pricing sounds cheap at 10K events, but SaaS products are event-heavy. At 1M events/month you're paying $300–800/month. At 10M, it's thousands. Your analytics bill grows faster than your revenue.

items.title: GA4 doesn't answer SaaS questions
items.description: Google Analytics tells you pageviews. It can't tell you which users completed your onboarding flow, how feature adoption correlates with retention, or why your trial-to-paid conversion dropped last month.

items.title: Complex tools slow down your team
items.description: Mixpanel's interface is powerful but has a steep learning curve. When it takes 30 minutes to build a simple funnel, your team stops using analytics to make decisions.

items.title: Cloud-only means full vendor dependence
items.description: If your vendor raises prices, you move or you pay. No self-hosting option, and a pricing model that punishes growth.

features.title: The full product analytics stack for SaaS
features.intro: Everything your team needs to understand users, reduce churn, and grow, without the enterprise pricing.

items.title: Event tracking
items.description: Track any user action: feature used, button clicked, settings changed, plan upgraded. One call. SDKs for the web, Node, React, Next.js, React Native, iOS, Android, Python and more.

items.title: Funnel analysis
items.description: Build conversion funnels for trial signup, onboarding, activation, and upgrade flows. See the exact step losing you the most conversions and fix it.

items.title: Retention analysis
items.description: A cohort grid shows whether users who signed up in week 1 are still active in week 8, with a weighted average that ignores weeks that have not happened yet. Pick any start and return event.

items.title: User profiles
items.description: Every event, session and replay for a specific user, plus the company they belong to through groups. Walk through a session to diagnose a support ticket or to see what power users do.

items.title: Cohort analysis
items.description: Group users by what they did or who they are: did an event at least N times in the last 30 days, or has a property. Use a cohort as a filter or a breakdown in any report.

items.title: Realtime dashboard
items.description: See sign-ups, trial activations and feature usage as they happen. Know within minutes when a deployment changes user behaviour.

items.title: Revenue tracking
items.description: Send revenue events from your billing webhooks and see revenue per user, per source and per campaign. Correlate feature usage with revenue without a separate BI tool.

items.title: Multi-platform SDKs
items.description: Web app, marketing site, iOS, Android and backend in one view. Events from every platform share the same user profiles.

faqs.title: Frequently asked questions
faqs.intro: Common questions from SaaS founders and product teams evaluating OpenPanel.

items.question: How is OpenPanel different from Mixpanel for SaaS?
items.answer: OpenPanel covers the same core analytics (events, funnels, retention, cohorts, user profiles) at a fraction of the cost, and adds session replay and AI observability. Mixpanel adds Metric Trees, feature flags and an experiment runner, which most SaaS teams do not use.

items.question: Can OpenPanel replace both GA4 and Mixpanel?
items.answer: Yes. OpenPanel includes web analytics (pageviews, referrers, UTM campaigns) alongside product analytics. Most SaaS teams can replace both tools with one OpenPanel deployment.

items.question: How do I track trial-to-paid conversions?
items.answer: Track a trial_started event on signup and a plan_upgraded event on conversion. Build a funnel or a conversion report between those two events and break it down by cohort, traffic source or any user property.

items.question: Does OpenPanel support multi-product or multi-tenant SaaS?
items.answer: Yes. Use profileId for the user and groups for the organisation or workspace (upsertGroup and setGroup in the SDK). Every group has its own page with members and events, and group properties work as filters and breakdowns.

items.question: What happens to my data if I stop paying for OpenPanel cloud?
items.answer: Export every event through the API, or set up an S3 or GCS export, at any time. Or migrate to self-hosting; there is no lock-in and no proprietary format.

items.question: Can I track backend events from my SaaS API?
items.answer: Yes. Use the Node, Express, Python, Ruby, Rust or Java SDKs with a client secret, or the REST API. Track subscription webhooks, background jobs and server-side logic alongside client events.

items.question: Is OpenPanel GDPR compliant for SaaS?
items.answer: Yes. Cookieless tracking by default, Cloud hosted on Hetzner in Germany with a DPA included, and the option to self-host for complete data sovereignty. No consent banner required for product analytics.
